title: api-evangelist/oumi
description: Oumi (Open Universal Machine Intelligence) is an open-source, Apache-2.0 platform for ML engineers and researchers to train, fine-tune, evaluate, and deploy foundation models (LLMs and VLMs) through a single unified interface.
raw_text_excerpt: Oumi (Open Universal Machine Intelligence) is an open-source, Apache-2.0 platform for ML engineers and researchers to train, fine-tune, evaluate, and deploy foundation models (LLMs and VLMs) through a single unified interface.
